operating_notes.text: Subsidiary Ticker Ltd reported NCLT Hyderabad Bench order directing RP to consider contentions on Baron Infotech's resolution plan.
Q4FY26 revenue included ₹41.68 Cr from trading segment, up from nil in Q4FY25.
Exceptional gain of ₹142.70 Cr from sale of business undertaking in Q4FY26.
Auditor qualified opinion due to pending civil suits related to National Spot Exchange.
Ticker Limited incorporated 63 Digital Asset Technologies Private Limited as a wholly owned step-down subsidiary with a subscription of ₹15,00,000.

timeline.summary: Jignesh P. Shah declared no encumbrance of shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
63 moons' subsidiary Ticker Ltd reported NCLT directions regarding resolution plan contentions for Baron Infotech.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹133.74 Cr (+880.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹22.5 Cr.
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹2 per equity share (FV ₹2) for FY 2025-26, pending shareholder approval and judicial orders.
Dewang Neralla declared no encumbrance of shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
On October 16, 2026, Ticker Limited incorporated a wholly owned step-down subsidiary named 63 Digital Asset Technologies Private Limited with an investment of ₹15 Lakh.
